title: The new-session dialog cannot set a workdir inside the selected project, so a session for a .worktrees task checkout needs the API
outcome: A person creating a root session in the UI can choose a working directory inside the selected project (for example .worktrees\<task>), so a second parallel task gets its own session in its own in-project checkout without a supervisor calling POST /api/sessions by hand.
acceptance: The new-session dialog cannot set a workdir inside the selected project, so a session for a .worktrees task checkout needs the API is done
